The '''MC30c Torpedo Frigate''' was a model of [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigate]] used by the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were equipped with [[assault proton torpedo]]es.<ref name="MC30c" />
